statements.proposition: In this change, useWorkspaceUpdateRole falls back to evicting the whole teamByRole cache field whenever previousRole is not provided.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: Only partly true: the fallback eviction exists in the user-removal branch (role null) but not in the role-update branch, where without previousRole the createUpdatedValue callback makes no updates and nothing is evicted (before the change teamByRole was evicted in all cases). The statement sits in a bullet covering both role updates and removals, so read as a general claim it is false. All three in-repo callers now pass previousRole, so no current caller hits the missing fallback; label rests on reading the statement as unconditional.
